0022600155.text: The Brooklyn Nets (0-5, 0-2 on the road) have lost five straight and sit 15th in the East, 4.5 games back in the Atlantic, with Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain) unavailable. The Indiana Pacers (2-3, 0-2 at home) have dropped their last two and are 10th in the East, 2.5 games back in the Central, and will be without Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), Obi Toppin (back soreness), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain). Indiana leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after beating Brooklyn 136-109 in Brooklyn on October 25, and the Nets also lost the 2025-26 series 1-2.
